basic_details.job_title: JPCH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital (JPCH), Department of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, will hold a walk-in interview for Senior Resident Doctors on 18 November 2026 (Wednesday) at 10:00 a.m. Candidates must report to the Administrative Block (5th Floor), Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi - 110053, where application forms are given out from 9 AM to 10:00 AM that day. The 7 adhoc posts are in Radiology (1), Obs & Gynae. (4), Anaesthesia (1) and Surgery (1), in Pay Level 11 (Rs.67700 – 208700) plus allowances as admissible under the rules.

age_limit.details: The age limit for Senior Residents is 45 years for Gen. and OBC candidates. SC/ST candidates get age relaxation as per rule. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age.

content_sections.heading: JPCH Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: 10:00 a.m.; application form available from 9 AM to 10:00 AM
Administrative Block (5th Floor), Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi - 110053
Senior Resident – Radiology, Obs & Gynae., Anaesthesia, Surgery
Rs.67700 – 208700 of level 11 plus allowances as admissible under the rules
MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned speciality and valid Delhi Medical Council registration

content_sections.heading: About JPCH
content_sections.text: Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital is a hospital under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, located at Shastri Park, Delhi - 110053. The notice dated 13 November 2026 was issued by Dr. Yogesh Kr. Gupta, I/C Residents. The hospital can be contacted on 011-22184453 and 011-22568802 (Fax 011-2184455) and at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All four posts carry the same pay, Rs.67700 – 208700 of level 11 plus allowances as admissible under the rules, and the same qualification. The category-wise break-up of the 7 vacancies is as printed in the notice: One post is reserved for a Physically Handicapped person as horizontal reservation of SR. The notice says the number of vacancies is provisional and subject to change without any notice, and that the number of vacant posts may vary. If candidates under the SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories are not available, the vacancies may be filled up from the General category. MBBS with P.G. Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned speciality from a recognized University / Institution. A valid registration with Delhi Medical Council. The candidate must not have completed 03 years Senior Residency in any recognized institution, including regular and adhoc period. In case of non-availability of candidates with PG Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned speciality, candidates having two years' experience in the department Obs. and Gynae from a Govt./Govt. aided institution may be considered. In case of non-availability of fresh candidates, candidates who have completed 3 years of Sr. residency may also be allowed to appear in the interview. The age limit for Senior Residents is 45 years for Gen. and OBC candidates. SC/ST candidates get age relaxation as per rule. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Only OBC/EWS certificates issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi are accepted, and they must have been issued before the date of interview. OBC candidates must have a Non Creamy Layer certificate for the current year along with the caste certificate. If an SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate is found fake or false, services will be terminated forthwith, without prejudice to further action under the provisions of the Indian Penal Code. Candidates should check the official notification for the speciality-wise eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to bring originals and photocopies of all the following documents at the time of interview: 01 passport size photo (point 2 of the conditions asks for two passport size photographs) Matriculation Certificate MBBS Degree MD/DNB/Diploma certificate Residence proof and DMC certificate Experience and Caste certificate, if any All the required certificates must be self-attested by the applicant and attached with the application.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Collect the application form from the Administration Branch of Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital between 9 AM and 10:00 AM on 18 November 2026. Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials and one passport size photograph. Report for the interview at the Administrative Block (5th Floor) with all original certificates and testimonials. Appear in the interview, which starts at 10:00 a.m. The mode of selection is through interview only. The competent authority reserves the right to decide in case of any dispute with regard to the selection process. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the JPCH Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 November 2026 (Wednesday) at 10:00 a.m. Application forms are available from 9 AM to 10:00 AM that day.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the JPCH walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: Candidates report to the Administrative Block (5th Floor), Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi - 110053.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 7 provisional vacancies: Radiology 1, Obs & Gynae. 4, Anaesthesia 1 and Surgery 1. One post is reserved for a Physically Handicapped person as horizontal reservation.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for JPCH Senior Resident?
faq.answer: MBBS with P.G. Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned speciality from a recognized University / Institution and valid registration with Delhi Medical Council. Candidates must not have completed 03 years of Senior Residency.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for Gen. and OBC candidates, with age relaxation for SC/ST candidates as per rule.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a JPCH Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs.67700 – 208700 of level 11 plus allowances as admissible under the rules.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Originals and photocopies of a passport size photo, Matriculation Certificate, MBBS Degree, MD/DNB/Diploma certificate, residence proof, DMC certificate, and experience and caste certificates, if any.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The mode of selection is through interview only.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JPCH Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on adhoc basis for 89 days, extendable to a maximum of 03 years including previous experience, or till the regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
